difficultyAxis: Contract and mapping trap through attribute width: a fourteen-attribute contract entity spanning every Java type family the corpus uses, including a List<String> collection attribute and pairs of BigDecimal, Double, LocalDate and LocalDateTime fields that map differently. The tempting mistake is to treat the collection as a plain column, to collapse BigDecimal and Double onto one type, or to declare the validation rules on the transport object instead of the domain model.
rationale: Five entities and fourteen scenarios, with the widest single entity in the graded set. The read and update scenarios require the collection attribute and the temporal attributes to survive a round trip unchanged, which a generator that only forwards scalar fields will fail while still passing every narrower tier.

userStories.intent: register a customer with a contact email
userStories.benefit: contracts can be attributed to a known owner

scenarios.given: a full name and a well-formed email address
scenarios.then: the customer is persisted with its verification flag

scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the customer
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

userStories.benefit: claims can be routed to an authorised repairer

scenarios.given: a unique service centre code and a two-letter country code
scenarios.when: the administrator registers the service centre
scenarios.then: the service centre is persisted and returned with its identifier

scenarios.given: a country code that is not two letters long
scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the service centre
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: register a warranty contract with a coverage list and a validity window
userStories.benefit: the covered product and period are recorded

scenarios.given: an existing customer, a non-empty coverage list and an end date after the start date
scenarios.then: the contract is persisted with its coverage codes and validity window intact

scenarios.given: a coverage end date earlier than the coverage start date
scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the contract
scenarios.then: the service rejects the contract as inconsistent

scenarios.given: a customer identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: the administrator attempts to register the contract
scenarios.then: the service reports the customer as not found

userStories.intent: submit a claim against a warranty contract
userStories.benefit: the repair cost is reimbursed under the correct contract

scenarios.given: an existing contract and a claimed amount above the permitted minimum
scenarios.then: the claim is persisted with its contract reference and an unsettled status

scenarios.given: a contract identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: the handler attempts to submit the claim
scenarios.then: the service reports the contract as not found

scenarios.given: a claimed amount below the permitted minimum
scenarios.when: the handler attempts to submit the claim
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: itemise a claim with the parts replaced
userStories.benefit: the approved amount can be justified line by line

scenarios.given: an existing claim and a quantity within the permitted range
scenarios.when: the handler adds the claim line
scenarios.then: the line is persisted against the claim with its unit cost and coverage flag

scenarios.given: a claim identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: the handler attempts to add a line to it
scenarios.then: the service reports the claim as not found

userStories.intent: settle a claim and remove a rejected line
userStories.benefit: the contract balance reflects only approved repairs

scenarios.given: an existing unsettled claim and an approved amount within the claim limit
scenarios.when: the handler updates the claim to settled
scenarios.then: the claim is persisted with the approved amount and the settled flag set

scenarios.when: the handler deletes the claim line
scenarios.then: the line is removed and the read that follows reports it as not found
